grep_options.description: List of grep command-line options. Each item must include 'name' (e.g., '-i', '-n'), optionally 'value' for options with arguments (e.g., '-m', '5'). Valid names are documented grep options starting with '-'. Not supported: --color/--colour (handled externally via GREP_COLORS). Do not include redundant duplicates (e.g., -i and --no-ignore-case together). Order matters if conflicting options exist (later overrides earlier).

exclude_patterns.description: List of glob patterns to exclude from recursive searches (equivalent to --exclude).

exclude_dir_patterns.description: List of glob patterns to exclude directories from recursive searches (equivalent to --exclude-dir).

include_patterns.description: List of glob patterns to include in searches (equivalent to --include).

exclude_from_file.description: Path to file containing glob patterns (one per line) to exclude from recursive searches (equivalent to --exclude-from).
